{
  "version": "1.70.73",
  "updatedAt": "2026-08-31",
  "standards": [
    {
      "id": "ui.base-components.first",
      "title": "Base Components First",
      "value": "whenever building UI, use the shared primitives demonstrated on the Base Components page (/studio/base-components, pageKey base-components, catalog src/features/base-components/); do not invent custom base controls, raw HTML form inputs/checkboxes/textareas, or ad-hoc HeroUI markup when a catalogued section exists; match the living sample for that section (component, props, sizes, intents, chrome); Base Components is the visual source of truth — remaining projectStandards entries and topic shards are implementation detail for those primitives",
      "appliesTo": [
        "all new UI work",
        "forms",
        "dialogs",
        "toolbars",
        "grids",
        "buttons",
        "Base Components"
      ],
      "shard": "ui-core"
    },
    {
      "id": "ui.heroui.checkbox.use-uicheckbox",
      "title": "HeroUI Checkbox Standard",
      "value": "boolean toggles follow Base Components → Choice: use UiCheckbox (HeroUI Checkbox wrapper from shared/ui or components/ui/HeroFieldControls); never native HTML input type=checkbox",
      "appliesTo": [
        "checkbox",
        "boolean toggles",
        "multi-select lists",
        "filter toolbars",
        "form fields",
        "Base Components"
      ],
      "shard": "ui-core"
    },
    {
      "id": "ui.heroui.radio.use-uiradiogroup",
      "title": "HeroUI Radio Standard",
      "value": "boxed multi-option checkbox/radio lists follow Base Components → Choice: UiCheckboxChoiceList / UiRadioChoiceList (src/shared/ui/FormChoiceFields.tsx); single rows use UiCheckboxChoice; low-level UiRadioGroup with layout=contents only when a custom host is required; option label typography via resolveUiChoiceOptionLabelClass / resolveUiRadioLabelClass; stacked choice rows use UI_CHOICE_STACK_GAP_CLASS (gap-1); exclusive title+description options use option cards (ui.form.choice.option-cards) not radio dots; do not hand-roll HeroUI Radio rows or per-page row className tuning",
      "appliesTo": [
        "radio",
        "radio groups",
        "form fields",
        "settings forms",
        "wizards",
        "Base Components"
      ],
      "shard": "ui-core"
    },
    {
      "id": "ui.component.default-size",
      "title": "Default Form Control Size",
      "value": "match Base Components → Form fields group: sm is the default for form field controls (UiInput, UiSelect, UiTextarea, UiAutocomplete, UiCombobox, UiCheckbox, SemVerInput, UrlSegmentSlugInput, DesignerMaskInputField, DesignerDatePickerField); omit size or pass size=\"sm\"; prefer sm and md for routine forms, settings, modals, and toolbars — xs and lg are also supported (see src/shared/ui/heroFieldSize.ts) when a surface needs tighter or larger controls; size is not hard-limited to sm/md; use UiCombobox (HeroUI ComboBox) for typeable filterable pickers — not button-style UiAutocomplete; UiCombobox menuTrigger is focus (default, open list on focus), input (suggestions only after typing), or manual",
      "appliesTo": [
        "UiInput",
        "UiSelect",
        "UiTextarea",
        "UiAutocomplete",
        "UiCombobox",
        "UiCheckbox",
        "form fields",
        "settings forms",
        "create/edit modals",
        "Base Components"
      ],
      "shard": "ui-core"
    },
    {
      "id": "ui.visual.semantic-color-restraint",
      "title": "Semantic Color — Subtle and Small-Area",
      "value": "use gentle, concept-matched color to aid scanning — not decoration; prefer color on text, icons, badges, pills, and other small objects; keep large surfaces white/neutral slate (page shell #F8FAFC, cards #FFFFFF, sidebar/header un-tinted, modal body, grid host); never paint chrome from the operator accent; status badges use fixed emerald #10B981 / amber #F59E0B / red #EF4444 and must not follow Cranberry or Gray; reuse existing semantic maps (buttonSemantics.ts, ICON_ACTION_*_CLASS, APP_SURFACE_BOX_TONE_CLASS, grid action colors) — no ad-hoc palette entries; one or two accent hues per view is enough",
      "appliesTo": [
        "all pages",
        "forms",
        "panels",
        "labels",
        "badges",
        "icons",
        "status text"
      ],
      "shard": "ui-design-system"
    },
    {
      "id": "ui.theme-designer.user-scope",
      "title": "Theme Designer Is Per Login User",
      "value": "Theme Designer writes the logged-in user’s theme_presets attribute (same scope as accent_theme); the public catalog in workspace/theme-designer is the default each user starts from; Reset restores that catalog for the active swatch; admin edits are personal, not platform-wide; login screen stays the fixed default accent and does not load user tokens; not node or company scoped — see docs/standards/ui-design-system.md §1",
      "appliesTo": [
        "Theme Designer",
        "accent theme",
        "login",
        "user attributes"
      ],
      "shard": "ui-design-system"
    },
    {
      "id": "ui.visual.color-it",
      "title": "Operator Cue — Color It (رنگیش کن)",
      "value": "when an operator says “color it” / «رنگیش کن», add concept-matched accents only on small-area backgrounds, borders, fonts/labels, and icons — never large body fills; choose hue from content meaning first (identity indigo/violet, technical cyan, relation emerald/lime, caution/PK amber, danger rose, success emerald), then reuse FormSection / APP_SURFACE_BOX_TONE_CLASS / buttonSemantics maps; do not color every element — restraint beats rainbow; see docs/standards/ui-core.md §Color it",
      "appliesTo": [
        "dialogs",
        "forms",
        "panels",
        "property editors",
        "summary sidebars",
        "section labels",
        "badges",
        "icons"
      ],
      "shard": "ui-design-system"
    },
    {
      "id": "ui.copy.english-only",
      "title": "English-Only Application Copy",
      "value": "all user-facing strings in application source code (components, toasts, labels, agent activity, culture bundles, seeds, and eval fixtures) must be written in English; do not add Persian, Arabic, or other non-English UI copy in TS/TSX/JSON — RTL locale packs may keep direction and calendar settings but translation values stay English; markdown docs are exempt",
      "appliesTo": [
        "all UI copy",
        "culture bundles",
        "agent labels",
        "toasts",
        "forms",
        "modals",
        "seed data",
        "eval corpora"
      ],
      "shard": "ui-core"
    },
    {
      "id": "ui.visual.typography-hierarchy",
      "title": "Typography Hierarchy for First-Glance Scanning",
      "value": "vary size, weight, and case so users spot the topic at first glance; establish a clear ladder: page/section title → subsection label → field label → body/helper; reuse tokens where they exist (DIALOG_PRIMARY_HEADER_TITLE_CLASS, APP_SURFACE_BOX_TITLE_CLASS, field labels text-sm font-semibold, metadata text-xs text-slate-500); section labels may use text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500; use font-semibold or font-bold only for emphasis — do not make every line the same size and weight",
      "appliesTo": [
        "all pages",
        "forms",
        "dialogs",
        "panels",
        "headings",
        "labels",
        "helper text"
      ],
      "shard": "ui-design-system"
    },
    {
      "id": "ui.form.ui-color.unified-control",
      "title": "UI Color Unified Field Control",
      "value": "for ui_color fields, render a unified control with color picker and hex input inside one integrated field container",
      "appliesTo": [
        "ui_color fields",
        "form color controls"
      ],
      "shard": "ui-core"
    },
    {
      "id": "ui.form.label-over-input.container",
      "title": "Label Over Input Container Structure",
      "value": "for label-over-input fields, keep label and control in a single vertical container",
      "appliesTo": [
        "form field stacks",
        "label-over-input layouts"
      ],
      "shard": "ui-core"
    },
    {
      "id": "ui.form.label-over-input.spacing",
      "title": "Label Over Input Spacing",
      "value": "label start padding must be ps-[4px], and label-to-control spacing must be exactly 2px via gap-[2px], mt-[2px], or mb-[2px]",
      "appliesTo": [
        "form labels",
        "form field spacing"
      ],
      "shard": "ui-core"
    },
    {
      "id": "ui.form.field.side-align",
      "title": "Side Form Fields Share A Horizontal Midline",
      "value": "FormField layout=side (dense inspectors, dialog title bands) places the label in FORM_FIELD_SIDE_LABEL_COLUMN_CLASS beside the control; the row is flex items-center so label and value share one horizontal midline — do not items-start that row; stack layout stays label-over-input; see docs/standards/ui-core.md §Forms",
      "appliesTo": [
        "FormField",
        "layout=side",
        "inspectors",
        "dialog title bands"
      ],
      "shard": "ui-core"
    },
    {
      "id": "ui.form.field.hint.heroui-tooltip",
      "title": "Field Hints Use HeroUI Tooltip Only",
      "value": "operator field/label hints must use FieldHintTooltip (HeroUI Tooltip + info icon) via FormField hint prop or Settings labelInfo / SettingsNavScopeHint; never ordinary under-field helper paragraphs (e.g. text-[10px] text-slate-400), native title= attribute hints, or ad-hoc hint chrome; placeholders are for input examples only; dense grid ActionTooltip native title remains the sole performance exception; FormField/FormSection hint also feeds the page guide; see docs/standards/ui-core.md §Page guide",
      "appliesTo": [
        "FormField",
        "FieldHintTooltip",
        "SettingsNavScopeHint",
        "labelInfo",
        "forms",
        "hints",
        "tooltips",
        "page guide"
      ],
      "shard": "ui-core"
    },
    {
      "id": "ui.page-guide.hints",
      "title": "Page Guide Title And Hint On Explainable Controls",
      "value": "the studio page guide walks [data-page-guide] stops that have both title and hint; page content (toolbars, create, paging, dialogs, FormField/FormSection, designer, Data Studio) is first and shell header/sidebar chrome is last; skip Home nav and studio logo chrome; FormField hint, FormSection hint or description, FieldHintTooltip, Settings labelInfo, and PageHeaderToolbar description are auto-stops; AppButton intent=create, AppSplitButton intent=create, ToolbarSearchInput, ToolbarRefreshButton, ToolbarFilterRadioGroup, ToolbarFilterSelect, ToolbarFilterCheckbox, ToolbarFilterMatchLogicBadge, GridPagingFooter, and AppSearchBox are local page stops; generators and designer auto-CRUD must emit a plain-language hint on every generated field; sidebar trigger uses the Bot icon; click the companion to cycle body shapes; a CircleHelp control beside close in the bubble closes the tour and opens AppEndO chat and the companion leaves while the panel is open; the same CircleHelp beside close on the chat panel closes chat and restores the tour companion; drag it and release to hop it back under the bubble; the active hotspot stays visible and the bubble/companion do not cover it; bubble play/previous/next/done/close are ghost icon-only ICON_ACTION buttons with no visible labels; play shows a cyan circular countdown for the 8-second autoplay interval; hotspot dots swallow pointer events so the control underneath does not activate; do not invent filler hints on every existing field or unlabeled nav item; see docs/standards/ui-core.md §Page guide",
      "appliesTo": [
        "page guide",
        "FormField",
        "FormSection",
        "PageHeaderToolbar",
        "Component Designer",
        "auto CRUD",
        "generated UI"
      ],
      "shard": "ui-core"
    },
    {
      "id": "ui.form.field.invalid-border",
      "title": "Invalid Field Border",
      "value": "when UiInput, UiSelect, UiTextarea, UiAutocomplete, UiCombobox, SemVerInput, or UrlSegmentSlugInput is invalid (isInvalid), show a subtle rose border via HEROUI_FIELD_INVALID_BORDER_CLASS (!border !border-rose-300) from surfaceClasses.ts; default border is HEROUI_FIELD_BORDER_CLASS (!border-[#e2e8f0] plus focus-within/data-focus primary-500); composite fields use resolveHeroUiFieldBorderClass(isInvalid); FormField invalid or error props auto-pass isInvalid and errorMessage to the child control; validation hints default to feedbackPlacement overlay (tooltip above the control via FieldFeedbackShell, flipping below when the viewport or a clipping ancestor has no room) — pass feedbackPlacement below for under-control text-xs text-rose-600 — no heavy red fills or ad-hoc per-page invalid borders",
      "appliesTo": [
        "UiInput",
        "UiSelect",
        "UiTextarea",
        "UiAutocomplete",
        "UiCombobox",
        "SemVerInput",
        "UrlSegmentSlugInput",
        "form validation"
      ],
      "shard": "ui-core"
    },
    {
      "id": "ui.form.field.required-invalid-on-mount",
      "title": "Required Field Invalid On Mount",
      "value": "required fields show invalid border from initial render until the value passes validation — do not defer isInvalid until blur or submit; FormField required prop adds rose asterisk; pass invalid for empty required state and error only for meaningful messages (not the word Required); FormField showError=false hides helper text while keeping border; reference Sandbox text-fields and docs/standards/ui-core.md §Form field layout",
      "appliesTo": [
        "FormField",
        "UiInput",
        "UiSelect",
        "UiTextarea",
        "wizards",
        "create/edit forms"
      ],
      "shard": "ui-core"
    },
    {
      "id": "ui.form.field.use-ui-input",
      "title": "Use Shared UiInput And UiTextarea",
      "value": "product text entry must use UiInput, UiTextarea, or UiPasswordInput from src/shared/ui (Sandbox text-fields reference) — never raw HTML input type=text|search|password|number|email|tel|url or textarea for operator/admin forms; exceptions: type=file|hidden|color, and component-designer runtime/export parity widgets that intentionally emit native HTML",
      "appliesTo": [
        "UiInput",
        "UiTextarea",
        "UiPasswordInput",
        "form fields",
        "create/edit modals",
        "toolbars",
        "wizards"
      ],
      "shard": "ui-core"
    },
    {
      "id": "ui.form.field.auto-dir",
      "title": "Auto Text Direction From First Character",
      "value": "UiInput and UiTextarea default autoDir=true, and the Markdown editor defaults dir=auto: set dir from the first meaningful character via getContentTextDirection (RTL scripts → rtl, Latin → ltr); explicit dir=ltr|rtl always wins; autoDir is skipped for password/number/email/tel/url and similar machine-oriented types; pass autoDir=false on character-restricted identifier fields (slugs, object names, cron, workflow keys, hex, JSON/code, mono technical ids) where only Latin/allowed chars apply — auto-dir is not useful there; for display text (messages, notes, feedback) use DirectionalText / getDirectionalTextProps; reference Sandbox text-fields State → Auto direction, Sandbox markdown-editor Preview direction → auto, and docs/standards/ui-core.md §Form field layout",
      "appliesTo": [
        "UiInput",
        "UiTextarea",
        "DirectionalText",
        "Markdown editor",
        "DesignerMarkdownEditorField",
        "form fields",
        "RTL",
        "text direction"
      ],
      "shard": "ui-core"
    },
    {
      "id": "ui.form.field.validation-overlay",
      "title": "Field Validation Uses Overlay Balloon And Invalid Border",
      "value": "whenever a field is validated, set isInvalid (or FormField invalid) for the rose invalid border and pass error/errorMessage so FieldFeedbackShell shows the overlay balloon (feedbackPlacement overlay is the default; balloon prefers above and flips below when space is tight); do not use under-field text-rose paragraphs for field-level validation; feedbackPlacement below only when explicitly required; reference docs/standards/ui-core.md §Invalid field state",
      "appliesTo": [
        "FormField",
        "UiInput",
        "UiTextarea",
        "UiSelect",
        "field validation",
        "errorMessage"
      ],
      "shard": "ui-core"
    }
  ],
  "matchCount": 88,
  "truncated": true,
  "maxRules": 20,
  "knowledgeKinds": [
    "STANDARD",
    "ANTI_PATTERN"
  ],
  "agentsMdPointer": "See AGENTS.md hub and docs/standards/INDEX.md for topic shards.",
  "runtimeApi": "/api/project-standards",
  "shardHint": "Pass shard (e.g. ui-grid) to load the full markdown topic file."
}
